messages:
Anya: quick sync — planning verdant-60b bring-up for the pilot next week, want to lock priority on quant experiments and gate criteria
Marc: +1. what's the biggest risk right now?
Anya: two things: 1) 4-bit quant gives ~2.4x throughput but we saw a small ROUGE/QA drop on long-context tests, 2) memory & latency variability on p4d instances under batching
Taylor: can you paste the eval numbers? small diffs matter for the pilot (legal search use-case).
Anya: pasted below (latest smoke run):
```
eval_suite: longform-qa, rouge-l, factuality-check
float32 baseline: rouge-l=36.4, long-qa EM=71.3, factuality=0.88
nf4 (4-bit): rouge-l=35.1, long-qa EM=69.0, factuality=0.86
nf4 + KV-cache-prune: rouge-l=35.6, long-qa EM=69.6, factuality=0.87
quant-ptq (mixed int8): rouge-l=36.1, long-qa EM=70.9, factuality=0.885
```
Sophie: thanks. rough takeaway: int8 almost parity, nf4 has measurable drop but maybe acceptable with cache tweaks. Do we have latency/99p numbers?
Anya: p99 no-batch: float32=240ms, nf4=160ms, int8=170ms. p99 batch(8): float32=650ms, nf4=420ms, int8=430ms. variance on p4d observed +-30ms at peak
Marc: for pilot, SLA is 300ms p99 at concurrency 12 per model. nf4 looks good for latency but quality gap worries me. Suggest triage: run focused eval on legal-exact-match set + hallucination prompts. If nf4 fails, fallback policy to int8 for those routes.
Taylor: agree. propose priority order for experiments: 1) int8 smoke (fast) 2) nf4 + KV-prune tuning 3) nf4 + small-lm-recalibration (prompt/PEFT) 4) production rollout plan (canary->50%->100%)
Sophie: add checklist items: dataset slices to run (legal-exact, citations, hallucination probes), regen prompts for hallucination, A/B config flags, rollout rollback triggers (quality drop >1.5% EM or factuality -0.02).
Anya: wrote up short checklist and action owners:
- dataset slices: Taylor (today)
- nf4 KV-prune tuning: Marc (tomorrow)
- int8 smoke + perf: Sophie (today afternoon)
- canary config + fallback policy: Anya (mon)
- run regression alert: add eval hook to rollout that compares to float32 baseline: if EM down >1.0 -> auto rollback (SLO owner: Marc)
Marc: I'll queue the nf4 kernel variants on cluster-qa and set up a small 4-run sweep. also tagging @eng-runtime for kernel timing.
Anya: cool. next meet? quick stand at 11:30 PST to confirm results and decide canary date.
eval-bot: New eval run completed for verdant-60b on cluster-qa. run_id=rv-279999-3, artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/rv-279999-3/ (metrics attached) :white_check_mark:
Taylor: got it, I'll start the exact-match + citation checks now. I'll post results in this thread.
Sophie: thanks team. keep the rollout gate conservative given pilot customer expectations. :thumbsup:
Anya: noted — will post final gating checklist after the 11:30 sync.
